en: The image displays the ornate reverse side of a vintage postcard, dominated by decorative Cyrillic script and flourishes. In the center, a crest featuring three profile portraits and a banner with the name 'Братя Хаджолянъ' (Brothers Khadjolyan) and 'Варна' (Varna) is prominent. Handwritten text covers most of the available space, apparently in Bulgarian, with a few instances of French ('Les clichés sont conservés'). The card is aged, with some staining at the corners.
